_meta.note: Test fixture for npc-story-events NR1.3 (the real file is narrative-seed's character-vocab).

greet.description: The first line when the player arrives.
greet.negative: Not a farewell; says nothing about past deeds.

farewell.description: The line when the player leaves.

thanks.description: After the player helped this character.

refused.description: After the player turned it down.

spared.description: After the player won and let it go.

betrayed.description: After the player broke faith with it.

joins.description: As it joins the player's side.

taunt.negative: Not a threat of a specific consequence; no number, no promise.

rumor.description: A piece of world news or lore.
rumor.negative: Not a quest offer; the runtime decides whether a quest follows.

doctrine.description: The antagonist's voice when its faction adopts a counter-doctrine.
doctrine.negative: Reacts to the player's aggregate strategy, never to an encounter.

return-won.description: At home, after an outing that went well.
return-won.negative: Not praise for a specific kill; no number.

return-wiped.description: At home, after a party wiped or a siege failed.
return-wiped.negative: Not blame and not a lesson in tactics.

return-lost.description: At home, after a sector was lost.
return-lost.negative: Not a threat of more loss.

return-quiet.description: At home, after an outing with nothing notable.
return-quiet.negative: Not a greeting to a stranger; it knows the player was away.
